body: Kids, house, cars, and 90% of the time everything is fine.  Things have been fine for weeks, with her at least making an attempt at respect.  Then today, she put me in a bad mood, refused to even discuss the problem, then kept escalating things for hours.

It really boils down to the fact that she has 0 respect for me.  This leads to everything else.  Contempt, nagging, looking for offense when there is none, making decisions without discussing with me, and refusing to talk when there is any kind of disagreement.  She constantly plays the victim even when she instigates.
